current_firmware_role: Offline mathematical qualification image based on the historical private Pico source. Not an accepted hardware/release image.
prerequisite: Coordinator must supply the accepted repaired Pico source/commit hash after RAM, preservation, USB and M0-memory checks.
permitted_delta: Review patch V163-to-V164-math-only.patch changes one asin interval. Cumulative math adoption additionally requires the pinned component manifest and the V163/V161 lineage; this patch alone is not a complete math migration onto an older base.
preserve: Accepted memory primitive/allocator/ROM-binding implementations and their ABI. Do not restore old copies from this frozen source.
M4 and non-RP2040 M0 math code/data.
steps: Create an isolated copy of the accepted repaired base and record its full source/build identity.
Reconcile cumulative math source delta by function/file; merge the endpoint-bound patch only once the V163 math baseline is present.
Adapt only required build selections and math linker sections to the accepted RAM/stack/DMA layout; do not copy the complete old ports/picocalc tree or its memory map.
Build and audit undefined symbols/libgcc members, literal/veneer targets, both core stacks, heap/scratch/DMA disjointness, and preserved repaired memory/runtime bodies.
Requalify math accuracy and instruction deltas affected by integration; repeat M4/generic-M0 isolation against the accepted base. Old image timing/layout does not prove integrated-image timing.
Independent review, then a separate hardware packet/permission/window with preservation and full restoration; release only after those gates.

current_layout_reference.meaning: Historical offline image measurements; these are constraints to reconcile, not addresses to enforce on the repaired base.
